explanation: I Lakelurk si trovano presso la Miniera rubini Hill Mine, nelle caverne di Camp Guardian e negli Alloggi di vacanza Blue Paradise.

q: Qual è la strategia consigliata per affrontare i Lakelurk?
explanation: È consigliato evitare di affrontarli quando sono in gruppo e abbatterli il prima possibile.

q: Qual è l'obiettivo di Lucas Simms riguardo alla bomba di Megaton?
explanation: Lucas Simms vuole che la bomba al centro della città sia disarmata.

q: Quali oggetti unici indossa Lucas Simms?
explanation: Lucas Simms indossa un cappello da sceriffo e uno spolverino.

q: Qual è la caratteristica distintiva degli Splendenti?
explanation: Gli Splendenti risplendono nell'oscurità e emettono radiazioni.

q: Qual è la causa della luminescenza degli Splendenti?
explanation: La luminescenza è causata dall'assorbimento di radiazioni e dal filtraggio delle particelle radioattive.

q: Qual è il valore di un Libro Pre-Bellico per la Scriba Yearling?
explanation: La Scriba Yearling ricompenserà il giocatore con 10 punti XP e 100 tappi per libro.

q: Qual è la ricompensa per aver contribuito ad arricchire l'archivio della Scriba Yearling?
explanation: La ricompensa include 10 punti XP e 100 tappi.

q: Da chi è interamente popolata la cittadina sotterranea di Little Lamplight nella zona contaminata della Capitale?
options: Da soli adulti sopravvissuti alla guerra
Interamente da bambini di età inferiore ai 16 anni
Da scienziati ed ex dipendenti della Vault-Tec
Da ex prigionieri fuggiti dal Vault 87
explanation: Little Lamplight è abitata esclusivamente da minori di 16 anni, rimasti isolati dopo che gli adulti presenti durante la Grande Guerra morirono o si allontanarono.

q: Nel giorno della Grande Guerra del 23 ottobre 2077, quale gruppo rimase intrappolato nelle caverne di Little Lamplight dando origine alla comunità?
options: 82 studenti della scuola elementare Early Dawn Elementary con insegnanti e genitori
Un gruppo di ingegneri e ricercatori della Vault-Tec diretti al Vault 87
Un plotone di soldati americani in cerca di rifugio antiatomico
Un gruppo di mercanti diretti a Washington in cerca di provviste
explanation: Nel giorno dello scoppio della guerra, un gruppo di studenti elementari con accompagnatori si trovava nelle caverne e, dopo la scomparsa degli adulti, diede vita alla comunità di Little Lamplight.

q: Qual è la regola fondamentale stabilita a Little Lamplight per tutti i suoi abitanti al compimento del sedicesimo anno di età?
options: Vengono promossi alla carica di sindaco della cittadina
Vengono nominati insegnanti per educare i più piccoli
Vengono espulsi e successivamente fondano la cittadina di Big Town
Vengono arruolati come guardie di sicurezza al cancello principale
explanation: A causa dell'avversione verso gli adulti, i ragazzi al compimento dei sedici anni vengono allontanati da Little Lamplight, dando origine nel tempo alla vicina comunità di Big Town.

q: Qual è il ruolo storico e istituzionale del bunker di Lost Hills nella lore di Fallout?
options: È la sede principale e il quartier generale della Confraternita d'Acciaio
È il laboratorio segreto dove fu sviluppato originariamente il virus FEV
È la capitale ufficiale della Nuova Repubblica di California (RNC)
È la base operativa centrale dell'Enclave nella California meridionale
explanation: Lost Hills è il bunker governativo pre-guerra situato nel sud della California che divenne la sede centrale della Confraternita d'Acciaio dopo l'Exodus guidato da Roger Maxson.

q: Chi guidò l'evento noto come Exodus nel novembre del 2077 che condusse i militari nel bunker di Lost Hills?
options: Il capitano Roger Maxson con i suoi uomini e le famiglie
Il generale Constantine Chase insieme agli scienziati di Mariposa
Il Dottor Madison Li alla guida dei ricercatori della Cittadella
Il sindaco MacCready insieme ai superstiti della scuola elementare
explanation: Il capitano Roger Maxson guidò i soldati e le loro famiglie fuori dalla base di Mariposa verso il bunker di Lost Hills nel 2077, dando inizio alla storia della Confraternita.

q: Come vengono equipaggiati i paladini della Confraternita d'Acciaio presenti nel bunker di Lost Hills?
options: Indossano abiti blu con fodera gialla e usano armi leggere
Indossano tuniche marroni e impugnano pistole laser Wattz 1000
Indossano l'armatura potenziata T-51b e impiegano armi pesanti
Indossano armature standard della Confraternita con fucili d'assalto AK-112
explanation: All'interno della gerarchia e delle caste di Lost Hills, i paladini si distinguono per l'utilizzo dell'armatura potenziata T-51b e di armamenti pesanti.

q: Qual è il ruolo ricoperto da Loxley nella sezione Oldtown di The Hub nell'anno 2161?
options: È il capo della gilda dei ladri e riluttante all'uso della violenza
È il direttore della società di prestito FLC gestita da Lorenzo Giovanni
È un influente mercante d'armi in affari con il criminale Decker
È il sindaco eletto della cittadina commerciale della California
explanation: Loxley guida la gilda dei ladri a The Hub, distinguendosi per la sua avversione generale alla violenza rispetto ad altri criminali.

q: Quale prova richiede Loxley al giocatore per poter entrare a far parte della gilda dei ladri?
options: Infiltrarsi nella base militare di Mariposa e rubare i progetti segreti
Sconfiggere le guardie di sicurezza di Lorenzo Giovanni a The Hub
Infiltrarsi in casa di Daren Hightower per rubare la sua preziosa collana
Recuperare gli olonastri educativi dimenticati nel Vault 87
explanation: Per entrare nella gilda guidata da Loxley, il giocatore deve completare una missione di infiltrazione e furto sgraffignando la collana di Daren Hightower.

q: A quale celebre personaggio leggendario e cinematografico rimandano i manierismi e il finto accento inglese di Loxley?
options: A Robin Hood e al ritratto cinematografico di Kevin Costner
Al capitano Roger Maxson durante l'evento storico dell'Exodus
Al generale Constantine Chase ideatore del progetto Liberty Prime
Al banchiere rinascimentale Lorenzo de' Medici detto il Magnifico
explanation: Il personaggio di Loxley in Fallout 1 trae chiara ispirazione dalla figura di Robin Hood e dai relativi adattamenti cinematografici con il suo stile e il suo finto accento.

q: Qual è la vera attività svolta da Lorenzo Giovanni dietro la facciata della sua società di prestito a The Hub?
options: È un feroce strozzino che ricorre alla forza fisica tramite le sue guardie
È il capo ufficiale della gilda dei ladri nella sezione Oldtown
È un rispettabile banchiere i cui affari risalgono all'epoca pre-guerra
È un emissario segreto della Confraternita d'Acciaio nel sud della California
explanation: Sebbene si presenti come un imprenditore onesto e si faccia chiamare 'il Magnifico', Lorenzo Giovanni gestisce in realtà un'attività di strozzinaggio usando picchiatori per riscuotere i debiti.

q: Con quale noto esponente della malavita di The Hub ammette apertamente di avere legami e rapporti Lorenzo Giovanni?
options: Con Decker, il capo della metropolitana di The Hub
Con Loxley, il capo della gilda dei ladri di Oldtown
Con il capitano Roger Maxson fondatore della Confraternita
Con il dottor Madison Li scienziata della Cittadella
explanation: Lorenzo non esita a rivelare i suoi stretti rapporti con Decker, il potente boss della malavita di The Hub, arrivando a suggerire al giocatore di cercarlo per del lavoro.

q: Da quali celebri esponenti della storia italiana e della famiglia dei Medici derivano il nome e gli appellativi di Lorenzo Giovanni?
options: Da Lorenzo il Magnifico e dal papa Leone X (Giovanni de' Medici)
Da Niccolò Machiavelli e dai dogi della Repubblica di Venezia
Da Leonardo da Vinci e dai banchieri fiorentini del Quattrocento
Da Cesare Borgia e dai signori dello Stato Pontificio
explanation: Il nome e l'epiteto di Lorenzo Giovanni sono un chiaro omaggio storico alla famiglia Medici e a figure come Lorenzo il Magnifico e papa Leone X.

q: Qual era lo scopo originario per cui fu commissionato e progettato il robot gigante Liberty Prime prima della Grande Guerra?
options: Liberare Anchorage, in Alaska, dalla minaccia della Cina comunista
Proteggere il bunker governativo di Lost Hills dagli attacchi esterni
Gestire le finanze e i prestiti della Loan-Friendly Company a The Hub
Esplorare le caverne sotterranee e scoprire l'accesso al Vault 87
explanation: Liberty Prime fu creato originariamente dall'esercito americano insieme a General Atomics e RobCo per liberare Anchorage dai cinesi durante la guerra sino-americana del 2072.

q: Quale scienziata risolse i problemi di alimentazione energetica del Liberty Prime permettendone la riattivazione da parte della Confraternita d'Acciaio?
options: La maestra Carrie Delaney prima di scomparire
Il capitano Roger Maxson durante l'Exodus
Il generale Constantine Chase nel laboratorio della Cittadella
explanation: Nonostante la Confraternita non disponesse dell'energia necessaria, l'intervento della dottoressa Madison Li permise di superare i problemi di alimentazione e rimettere in funzione il robot.

q: Quali armi e caratteristiche offensive possiede il Liberty Prime durante gli scontri contro le forze dell'Enclave?
options: Lancia raggi laser dagli occhi e scaglia esplosivi simili a mini-nuke dalla schiena
Utilizza fucili d'assalto AK-112 e armatura potenziata T-51b come i paladini
Spara con pistole laser Wattz 1000 e indossa vesti marroni da scriba

explanation: Primm Slim is a robot residing in the Vikki and Vance Casino in Primm, acting as a tour guide for the small-time museum in the building, in the Mojave Wasteland.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Easy Pete is a former prospector living in the town of Goodsprings in 2281. Easy Pete used to be a prospector, looking for working tech, unexpired chems and guns to sell.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Ringo is a trader for the Crimson Caravan Company operating in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281, forced into hiding in Goodsprings after a run-in with the Powder Gangers.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mortimer is a cannibal and high-ranking member of the White Glove Society that operates the Ultra-Luxe on the New Vegas Strip in 2281. He serves as the hotel maître d' as well as the right-hand man of the organization's founder Marjorie.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Heck Gunderson, called "Hurricane Heck" for his unscrupulous business practices, is a brahmin baron from California visiting New Vegas in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Ranger Andy is a former member of the New California Republic Rangers, presently retired and living in Novac in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Martin Frobisher is the spokesman for the Vault 13 inhabitants in 2241. Imprisoned in the medical testing detention center aboard the Enclave Oil Rig, Martin is part of the group of residents abducted from Vault 13 and their unofficial spokesman.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Sunny Smiles is a resident of Goodsprings in 2281, serving as a dedicated town guard as well as a small-time gecko hunter.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Nora is a pre-War resident of Sanctuary Hills in 2077 and one of the two possible player characters available during character creation. The player can customize her appearance and, if chosen as the player character, her name and SPECIAL stats.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Veronica is a resident of Vault 33. Following the raid on Vault 33 by the residents of Vault 32, Veronica was assigned to supervise the surviving prisoners alongside two armed guards.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: 00 |factions =BoomerFaction |class =SettlerNV |combat style=Default |GECK race =HispanicOldAged |edid =NellisPearl |formid = |refid = }} Pearl is a former resident of Vault 34 and the leader of the Boomers tribe inhabiting Nellis Air Force Base in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Jackal gang members are members of the Jackals tribal-gang in the Mojave Wasteland in the year 2281. These low-level raiders are encountered relatively early, appearing primarily in the area south of Goodsprings and west of Camp Searchlight.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Simon is an employee of the Van Graffs merchant family, acting as the door guard for the Silver Rush in Freeside in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Aurelius of Phoenix is a centurion of Caesar's Legion and commanding officer of the Legion garrison at Cottonwood Cove in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: The Sole Survivor is the player character and main protagonist. Depending on the player character's gender, the Sole Survivor is either the husband or wife (name determinant) in a pre-War family and has a son, Shaun.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Shaun (designation: S9-23) is a prototype synth created by the real Shaun and lives in the Institute, unless the Sole Survivor opts to destroy the Institute during the mission The Nuclear Option, after which he can be sent to the Commonwealth or left to die in the Institute's nuclear explosion.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Doctor Alex Richards is the primary medical care provider for the New California Republic Army troops stationed at Camp Forlorn Hope.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Dogmeat is a dog found in a scrapyard near Minefield in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. He is a possible companion of the Lone Wanderer.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Izo is a martial arts master serving Gizmo in Junktown, in 2161. Not much is known about this man. However, Izo is known to be a special martial artist and silent.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Neil is a first-generation super mutant residing near Black Mountain in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Rotface is a gossiping ghoul beggar residing at Freeside in 2281. Rotface is sitting against a destroyed building next to Mick & Ralph's, just past Freeside's east gate.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Kenji is an assassin sent by Gizmo to kill Killian Darkwater in 2161. Kenji was hired by Gizmo to kill Killian Darkwater.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: The NCR Veteran Rangers, also called NCR Ranger veterans or NCR combat Rangers, are the elite members of the New California Republic Rangers in service to the New California Republic, encountered.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: NCR military police are NCR troopers serving as military police, patrolling the New Vegas Strip and guarding the NCR Embassy in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Maxwell "Max" Stone, also known as the Vault Dweller, is an inhabitant of Vault 13 in 2161. He is the player character in the 1997 Fallout Demo.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Rhonda is a robot and companion of the nightkin Tabitha at Black Mountain in the Mojave Wasteland until her deactivation in the past. She appears.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Tyler is the leader of a small gang in the Den East Side in 2241. A strong man in metal armor, Tyler was hired by Metzger to guard a church filled with the raw chemicals used to make Jet.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Dead Sea is a decanus of Caesar's Legion in the Mojave Wasteland who led the assault on the NCR outpost at the town of Nelson, taking it as a base for the Legion and starting a brutal ground war against the Army forces at the nearby Camp Forlorn Hope in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Manny Vargas is a former Great Khan who is a veteran NCR Army sniper living in Novac.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Lara is the leader of a small gang on the Den West Side in 2241. She lost out on a chance to guard Metzger's church to Tyler, a rival gang leader, and now wishes to take the job by force with some help.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Chomps Lewis is the foreman of the Quarry Junction mining operation for the New California Republic in the Mojave Wasteland, recently forced out by an infestation of deathclaws and sheltering in the nearby worker town of Sloan in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Doctor Usanagi is a Followers physician in charge of the New Vegas medical clinic. She offers a variety of healing services and access to permanent stat-boosting implants.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Yes Man is an AI program that serves as Benny's assistant and right-hand man in 2281. He is a modified PDQ-88b Securitron with a unique personality, serving as an integral part of Benny's scheme to take control of New Vegas.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: png |race =Human |gender =Male |affiliation =New California Republic |role =Vice President of the NCR |family =Mrs. msg }} Frank Carlson is a politician and the vice-president of the New California Republic in 2241. He is a minor character.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Decanus Severus is a member of Caesar's Legion, serving as quartermaster and second-in-command to Centurion Aurelius of Phoenix at Cottonwood Cove in the Mojave Wasteland.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mr. New Vegas is an artificial intelligence created by Mr. House before the Great War, serving as a radio host and DJ that was put in charge of Radio New Vegas for House's Free Economic Zone of New Vegas following the nuclear apocalypse, a role he continues to occupy by 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Jean-Baptiste Cutting is the head of security for the Mojave Wasteland branch of the Van Graffs weapons empire. He is Gloria Van Graff's half-brother and her right-hand man, living at the Silver Rush weapon shop in Freeside in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Super mutants are characters living in the Midwest in 2197. They were created by the Master 40 years ago, are generally strong but stupid, and because of their bulk cannot wear human armor or use small weapons.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Recruit legionaries are members of Caesar's Legion encountered in the Mojave Wasteland, forming the backbone of the Legion's armies as frontline fighters during the NCR-Legion War in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: {{Rotating content |content1={{quotation|{{Tooltip|What the hell? You're that courier Benny wasted back in Goodsprings. Their return trip to Red Rock Canyon would later end up stalled due to getting trapped in Boulder City, locked in a stalemate against the New California Republic Army.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Codsworth is a robot residing around Sanctuary Hills in the Commonwealth in 2287. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Ted Gunderson is the son of Heck Gunderson, a wealthy Californian brahmin baron. By 2281, he is secretly being held captive by the White Glove Society in the Ultra-Luxe on the New Vegas Strip.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: {{Quotation|{{tooltip|Oh, that chem-pusher didn't tell you? |{Irritated} }}}} Trudy is a trader living in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Wernher is an escaped slave and former right-hand man of Ishmael Ashur from The Pitt.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Lydia is the owner and proprietor of the Tap House in downtown Vault City in 2241.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Scribe Peabody is the proctor of the Order of the Sword, in charge of the armory for the chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel in the Citadel in 2277.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Shelly Tiller is a wastelander sheltering at the National Guard training yard in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Craig Boone is a former member of the New California Republic's First Recon sharpshooter regiment, now retired and residing in Novac where he serves as the night watchman in 2281. He is a possible companion of the Courier.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Rose is the de facto leader of the Cutthroats raider faction in Appalachia. Initially thought by the Vault 76 overseer to be a human that had sheltered themselves away at the apex of the Top of the World ski resort and thus survived the ravages of the Scorched Plague, the Vault Dweller that eventually makes their way to the observation deck finds that Rose is not what the Overseer had in mind.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Ricky Dalton is a Railroad informant operating in the Commonwealth in 2287. Ricky's extensive knowledge of Boston and the outlying landscape had earned him the watchful eye of Railroad operatives.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Coursers are elite synth operatives designated to carry out specific surface missions for the Institute, such as tracking down escaped synths. They operate around the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Earl Marion is the sheriff of the mining town of Redding in 2241. Earl Marion is a powerful-looking black man. He supports the NCR as the future of the wasteland and is very friendly towards New California Rangers.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: NCR Rangers are members of the NCR's elite New California Republic Rangers, operating in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Sergeant Baker is a member of the Gunners in the Commonwealth in 2287. Sergeant Baker is one of the residing Gunner leaders at the Quincy ruins.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: {{Quotation|{{tooltip|Ah, the detective is back! ogg|Vadim Bobrov to Nick Valentine}} Vadim Bobrov is the bartender and co-owner of the Dugout Inn, living in Diamond City in 2287.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Talon Company mercs are members of the Talon Company, a mercenary company operating in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Wayne Delancy is an assassin working for Sinjin in the The Commonwealth in 2287. They appear in Fallout 4.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: The Vault Dweller, as a group referred to as Vault Dwellers and Seventy-Sixers, and individually as Seven-Six, among other designations, such as Ressies, Vault Residents (or simply Residents) and Vaulters are the former residents of Vault 76 and the player characters.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Beckett is a former member of the Blood Eagles and possible ally in Appalachia. He says that he is a reformed man who has moved on from the cruel raider lifestyle, having previously killed people for as little as looking at him the wrong way.

q: Who is shown in the picture?
explanation: Commander Sofia Daguerre is a United States Space Administration astronaut that crash-landed in Appalachia after awakening from her space-bound cryostasis in 2103. She is a potential ally.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Aliens are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Three aliens can be found to the north of the Horowitz farmstead and east of Brooks tumbleweed ranch, where the mercenary camp is usually located, when one does not have the Wild Wasteland trait, with an inaccessible, crashed recon craft.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: A mirelurk refers to any one of three mutated crustaceans that dwell in the swamps of the Commonwealth and are commonly found around the Island in 2287.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Anglers are creatures that appear in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor. Anglers are aggressive creatures native to the Island.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Hairy deathclaws are mutated creatures in Fallout Tactics: Brotherhood of Steel.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mole rats are creatures found in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. Mole rats are mutated rodents that are much larger than their ancestral species prior to the Great War.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Brahmin are creatures living in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Descendants of pre-War cattle, brahmin are very weak animals that have been domesticated and herded throughout the years since the Great War.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Spore plants are creatures found in Arroyo and random encounters around Arroyo in 2241. The Professor living in Broken Hills has created an intelligent, talking spore plant named Seymour.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Lakelurks are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Lakelurks are mutated, bipedal creatures that live close to bodies of water such as Lake Mead, the Colorado River, the Camp Guardian caves, Blue Paradise Vacation Rentals, and Ruby Hill Mine.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Wanamingos, also referred to as aliens or alien things, are mutant creatures that appear in Fallout 2. In Fallout 2, they are called "wanamingos" in Redding, after the Great Wanamingo Mine, and "aliens" elsewhere, but eventually, the name "wanamingo" came to be used for the species as a whole across the wastes.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: The Mister Handy is a variant of robot found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Mister Handy robots are service and maintenance robots, with a powerful propulsion system enabling them to hover a few feet above ground.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Assaultrons are a type of robot encountered in the Commonwealth, on the Island, and in Nuka-World in 2287.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Holograms are three-dimensional projections which sometimes interact with the player and non-player characters in Sierra Madre in 2281.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Floaters are creatures found in Appalachia. Floaters are mutated creatures that are the product of experimentation with the Forced Evolutionary Virus.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Tunnelers are creatures found in the Divide. Ulysses speculates that they may be a result of the Great War. After the bombs fell, radiation heavily mutated them, adapting them for an underground life.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Stingwings are flying creatures in the Commonwealth in 2287. Stingwings are a type of mutant insect which inhabit various locales in the Commonwealth as of 2287.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Night stalkers (sometimes spelled "nightstalkers") are creatures living in the Mojave Wasteland and Big MT in 2281.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Support drones are alien robots encountered in the Fallout 3 add-on Mothership Zeta.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Radscorpions are mutated arachnids found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Radscorpions are mutated, via radiation and exposure to the Forced Evolutionary Virus, from the North American Emperor scorpion, which were prolific in many pet stores at the time of the Great War.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Gatorclaws are creatures encountered in the Safari Adventure park in Nuka-World.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Gulpers are creatures in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor. Gulpers are mutated salamanders that roam the Island. They continue to grow throughout their lives, and can reach sizes several times larger than a man.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Giant ants are mutated insects found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Research conducted by Enclave scientists in the Capital Wasteland identified these enlarged mutated arthropod insects as belonging to the Formicidae family, genus Camponotus, most likely black carpenter ants, though the sheer number of members in said genus makes a precise identification difficult.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Shop-Tec is a Vault-Tec robotic system implemented in the company's Corporate Vault. It consists of a network of terminals that is designed as a shopping interface for the vault dwellers. The system was adapted to accept caps as currency. Shop-Tec terminals appear like big, arcade-like boxes.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Automated turrets are automated, stationary laser and machine gun systems which appear in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Cazadores (Spanish for "hunters") are mutated insects found in the Mojave Wasteland, Big MT, and Zion Canyon in 2281.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Flatwoods monsters, known before the War as the Green Monster, are extraterrestrial creatures encountered in Appalachia and expanded upon in the Invaders from Beyond update.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: The Eyebot is a type of robot in 2281. Eyebots are aerial, spherical robots with a loudspeaker and electrical zapper on the front and several long antennas protruding from its top and back.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Feral ghouls are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Feral ghouls are similar in appearance to sapient ghouls, but with deformed facial features.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Cultists are enemies found in Appalachia, fanatical members of the Followers of the Winged One, a sect of the Cult of the Mothman who continued to dwell in the Lucky Hole Mine after the Great War. They densely populate their settlements and camps. They can also be encountered in Daily Ops.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Wolves are creatures living on the Island in 2287. The centuries of radiation exposure on the Island have done remarkably little to the local wolves population.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: The Robobrain is a type of robot found in the Capital Wasteland. Robobrains are a fairly common sight in the Capital Wasteland.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mirelurk queens are creatures found in Appalachia. The mirelurk queen is the largest enemy one can encounter in-game besides the scorchbeast queen and behemoth.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Radroaches are mutated insects found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. These mutated Great American cockroaches, colloquially called "radroaches," or simply "giant cockroaches," are enlarged versions of the pre-War species that have exponentially increased in size, due to atomic fallout.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mega sloths, also known as megasloths, are creatures found in Appalachia. Before the Great War, Isaac Garrahan owned several sloths at his family's estate.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Honey beasts are creatures encountered in Appalachia. The creatures called "honey beasts" are the mutated descendants of ordinary honeybees that were exposed to high levels of radiation following the Great War.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Think tanks, also known as brainbots, are a type of brain bot encountered. Sometime prior to the Great War, the scientists of Big MT devised a project that sought to develop a fusion of organic and synthetic that would allow a disembodied human brain to live and continue the pursuit of technological advancement long past the expiration of the human body.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Robo-scorpions are a type of robot encountered in Big MT. Designed to serve the role of a special security force by the Big MT research company for the Big Mountain Research and Development Center, the original robo-scorpion was created before the Great War by the human who became Doctor Mobius and his team in the X-42 robo-warfare facility in Big MT, basing the design off that of the Southwest's indigenous bark scorpion.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Deathclaws are creatures living in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. They are a large, agile, and strong species of mutant Jackson's chameleon and are far more common in the Capital Wasteland than on the West Coast despite the more desolate, barren and desert-like characteristics of the wasteland.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Vertibots are robots found in Appalachia. Developed before the Great War, Vertibots are automated vertibirds utilized by the United States Armed Forces.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Cats are creatures found in Appalachia. Before the Great War, domestic cats were a popular household pet. They were known for their companionship and for hunting common household pests, such as rats.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Protectrons are a type of robot encountered in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. S. Army before the Great War of 2077. They are painted a dark olive drab with a white star on their chest.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: The behemoth is the largest and most dangerous of the robots used by the Calculator, the mad cyborg from Vault 0, in The Belt in 2197.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Trogs are creatures encountered in the Pitt. Trogs are heavily deformed humans who have been mutated by the radiation and toxic pollutants from the many factories in Pittsburgh.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Cyberdogs, also spelled as cyber dogs, are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland and in Big MT.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Bloodbugs are a species of mutated, ectoparasitic mosquitoes found in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Rats are creatures found in New California. These creatures can range from standard disease-ridden wharf rats to the somewhat larger - and hungrier - mutant Chihuahua-sized rats.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Snallygasters are creatures found in Appalachia. Experiments with recombinant strains of FEV at the West Tek research center in Appalachia produced numerous failed mutations, with two exceptions.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mister Orderly is a medical robot model created by General Atomics International. It is a medical version of the GAI/RobCo model Mister Handy.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Giant rats are creatures living in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Giant rats appear to be larger versions of normal pre-War rats, although they appear to have lost most of their fur.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Laser turrets are turrets found in the Midwest in Fallout Tactics. A laser turret is an automated defense system with a single-barrel laser cannon, which will lower down after a few seconds for cover.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Ants are creatures that appear in Nuka-World in 2287. Unlike their Capital Wasteland and Mojave Wasteland counterparts, the species of ants found around Nuka-World are relatively small, more comparable to those found in Northern California and Broken Hills with larger specimens being around the same size as a medium-large sized radroach.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Third generation synths, or gen 3 synths, are the apex of the Institute's research into creating a race of servants necessary to maintain their subterranean habitat.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: House cats are creatures found in the Commonwealth, on the Island, and in Nuka-World in 2287.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Bighorners are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland, and Zion Canyon in 2281.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Liberators are robots found in Appalachia. Liberators were small pre-War drones used by the People's Liberation Army. These military infiltration and attack robots were weak and ineffective, and became a joke among soldiers who were forced to waste ammunition on them.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Radstags are the mutated descendants of the Commonwealth and the Island's local deer population in 2287.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: The marked men are a unique variant of ghoul encountered exclusively within the region known as the Divide in the former American Southwest. They appear as supporting antagonists.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Centaurs are mutants found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. In this type of centaur, only the human-like head and torso remain, and the spines on the back are replaced by three long, tentacle-like tongues.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mole miners are creatures found in Appalachia. A bleak remnant of Appalachia's storied past, the mole miners are a mutated form of human that make their homes in the many caves, mines, and above-ground mining locales of the region.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Dogs are animals commonly found in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. Though 200 years have passed since the Great War, dogs have stayed generally unaltered by radiation.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Grafton Monsters are creatures encountered in Appalachia. Until the late 21st century, the "Grafton Monster" was largely a mythical creature which drew cryptid hunters to the namesake town of Grafton, West Virginia.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Coyotes are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Similar to dogs, coyotes do not appear to have been visibly altered after the Great War.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: The Komodo dragons or simply Komodos are mutated giant lizards found commonly in the Midwest in Fallout Tactics.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Guardian drones are alien robots encountered on board the Mothership Zeta. Guardian drones are a more advanced model of the support drone, and they are armed with a drone cannon.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Sentry bots are a model of robot found in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. Sentry bots have two arms equipped with powerful weapons: a minigun or Gatling laser on their right, and a missile launcher on their left.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Ghost people, also called locals and/or Villa inhabitants, are hostile mutated creatures found in the Sierra Madre.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mirelurk hunters are creatures found in Appalachia. Hunters are mirelurks with high mobility and melee damage. The lack of a hardened carapace means that they have slightly less concentrated armor protection, however, they have superb overall protection, meaning they are not nearly as vulnerable to headshots.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Mutant hounds or FEV hounds are creatures found in the Commonwealth and are present on the Island in 2287.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: The hermit crab is a creature in the Fallout 4 add-on Far Harbor. Hermit crabs are giant creatures on par with fog crawlers, mirelurk queens and super mutant behemoths.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: The gorilla is a synthetic creature found contained inside the terrariums of Institute BioScience in 2287. With the Wasteland Workshop add-on, they can be captured in cages and domesticated in settlements owned by the Sole Survivor.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Bloatflies are insects in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. Individually, they do not inflict much damage, but in swarms, bloatflies can be a moderate threat to low-level player characters (especially companions).

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Miss Nannies are a type of robot appearing in the Commonwealth and the Island in 2287.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Yao guai are creatures residing in Zion Canyon. The physical build of the Zion variant does not drastically deviate from pre-War bears as much as other cases of yao guai found in the Capital Wasteland and the Commonwealth.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Geckos are creatures in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. Geckos can be found living across the entire Mojave Wasteland, with many different species calling the local area their breeding grounds.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?
explanation: Fire ants are creatures living in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. They are a variation of giant ants that have been genetically modified, and their name comes from their ability to expel a flammable acid from their mandibles.

q: Which creature is shown in the picture?

explanation: Swank is a member of the Chairmen operating the Tops casino on the New Vegas Strip in 2281, serving as the right-hand man to their leader Benny.

q: In which game do you meet the character "Tabitha"?
explanation: Tabitha is the nightkin leader of the State of Utobitha and dedicated radio host at Black Mountain in 2281.

q: In which game do you meet the character "Ted Gunderson"?
explanation: Ted Gunderson is the son of Heck Gunderson, a wealthy Californian brahmin baron. By 2281, he is secretly being held captive by the White Glove Society in the Ultra-Luxe on the New Vegas Strip.

q: In which game do you meet the character "The King"?
explanation: The King is the leader of the Kings street gang operating out of the King's School of Impersonation and the de facto ruler of Freeside in 2281.

q: In which game do you meet the place "The Pitt"?
explanation: The Pitt is a raider-dominated city built in the ruins of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, established in the aftermath of the Great War by local gangs trying to take over in the chaos. Around 2255, its inhabitants were nearly wiped out by an expeditionary force of the Brotherhood of Steel, only to be revitalized by Ishmael A

q: In which game do you meet the faction "Think Tank"?
explanation: The Think Tank refers to a group of pre-War scientists that control the advanced facilities of Big MT in 2281, having survived the nuclear apocalypse and subsequent centuries by removing their brains for placement in robotic shells.

q: In which game do you meet the faction "Three Families"?
explanation: The Three Families are the ruling authorities of the casinos of the New Vegas Strip and employees of Mr. House's Free Economic Zone of New Vegas, consisting of the Chairmen, the Omertas, and the White Glove Society.

q: In which game do you meet the place "USS Constitution"?
explanation: The USS Constitution is an 18th-century heavy frigate formerly in the service of the United States Navy and is a location in the Charlestown district of Boston in the Commonwealth.

q: In which game do you meet the character "Usanagi"?
explanation: Doctor Usanagi is a Followers physician in charge of the New Vegas medical clinic. She offers a variety of healing services and access to permanent stat-boosting implants.

q: In which game do you meet the place "Vault-Tec headquarters"?
explanation: The Vault-Tec headquarters is a location in the Vernon Square area of the Washington, D.C. ruins in Fallout 3.

q: In which game do you meet the place "Vault 101"?
explanation: Vault 101 is a Vault-Tec Vault located in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. It is found in Virginia, in the area northwest of Washington, D.C.

q: In which game do you meet the place "Vault 111"?
explanation: Vault 111 is a Vault-Tec Vault in the Commonwealth in 2287, and a location in Fallout 4.

q: In which game do you meet the character "Veronica Santangelo"?
explanation: Veronica Renata Santangelo is a journeyman scribe in the Mojave chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel, presently residing at the 188 Trading Post in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281. She is a possible companion of the Courier.

q: In which game do you meet the character "Yes Man"?
explanation: Yes Man is an AI program that serves as Benny's assistant and right-hand man in 2281. He is a modified PDQ-88b Securitron with a unique personality, serving as an integral part of Benny's scheme to take control of New Vegas.

q: Who did this? This Fallout 4 parent searches the Commonwealth for their missing son after waking from a long sleep.
explanation: After finding Valentine, they learn the identity and location of their spouse's killer, a man named Conrad Kellogg.

q: What job did the Courier have in Fallout: New Vegas?
options: running a detective agency in Diamond City
leading the Chairmen on the Strip
delivering packages for the Mojave Express
explanation: In 2281, the Courier was one of six messengers hired by the Mojave Express at Robert House's behest to deliver packages to the New Vegas Strip.

q: Who did this? This Fallout: New Vegas protagonist carried a valuable package toward the Strip before being ambushed near Goodsprings.
explanation: Of the six, it was the Courier that was carrying the only item of worth, the platinum chip.

q: What did the Lone Wanderer help Moira Brown do in Fallout 3?
options: collect data for her Wasteland Survival Guide
explanation: During their journey, canonically they disarmed Megaton's namesake atomic bomb and helped collect data for Moira Brown's Wasteland Survival Guide,

q: What work is Nick Valentine known for in Fallout 4?
options: solving cases as a private detective
delivering packages for the Mojave Express
explanation: Nick Valentine is a synth residing in Diamond City in the Commonwealth in 2287, solving cases as the owner and sole detective of Valentine Detective Agency.

q: Who did this? This synth in Diamond City solves cases and may join the Sole Survivor as a companion.
explanation: He appears as a possible companion of the Sole Survivor and is expanded upon in the Far Harbor add-on.

q: What does Preston Garvey do for the Minutemen in the Commonwealth?
options: writes a survival guide in Megaton
delivers packages to the New Vegas Strip
defends refugees from raiders in Concord
explanation: Preston Garvey is a member and officer of the Commonwealth Minutemen operating in the Commonwealth in 2287, defending refugees under his protection from an attack by raiders in Concord.

q: Who did this? This Minutemen officer protects refugees in Concord and works to rebuild the group in the Commonwealth.
explanation: Preston Garvey is a member and officer of the Commonwealth Minutemen operating in the Commonwealth in 2287, defending refugees under his protection from an attack by raiders in Concord.

q: What does Danse do in the Commonwealth in Fallout 4?
options: Runs the newspaper in Diamond City
explanation: serving as the commanding officer of Recon Squad Gladius in the Commonwealth in 2287.

q: Who did this? This Brotherhood paladin commands a reconnaissance squad sent to the Commonwealth and can join the player as a companion.
explanation: serving as the commanding officer of Recon Squad Gladius in the Commonwealth in 2287. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.

q: What does Piper Wright do for the people of Diamond City?
options: Repairs power armor for the Brotherhood

options: The New Vegas Followers of the Apocalypse

q: What was Veronica Santangelo designated as after the fall of HELIOS One?
explanation: To keep her away from the elder and the bunker heads, she was designated a procurement specialist and permitted outside the bunker to make regular supply runs and obtain provisions and other necessities for her peers.

q: Who did this? She criticized Brotherhood policies and was allowed to make regular supply runs for her peers.

explanation: Overwhelmed by Bob, he stopped to rest, only to realize that he was unable to move anymore, rooted to the ground by his companion. He became part of the tree, sustained by its photosynthesis and nutrients taken from the ground.

explanation: Moira Brown is the proprietor of the general store Craterside Supply in Megaton in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

explanation: Following the fall of Shady Sands, Moldaver leads a division of New California Republic forces in Los Angeles by 2296.

explanation: He is the director of the Institute in 2287.

q: Who did this? This leader of the Institute, also called Father, is the son of the Sole Survivor’s spouse in Fallout 4.

q: Who did this? This super mutant leader helped found towns like Broken Hills and Jacobstown, then served as a local leader.

tracking a man's scent for miles

explanation: Dogmeat, initially named just Dog, is a dog residing around the Red Rocket truck stop in the Commonwealth in 2287.

explanation: a volunteer militia operating in the namesake Commonwealth.

q: Who did this? This Securitron AI character assists the Courier and helps enable a major ending in Fallout: New Vegas.
explanation: Yes Man appears as a major character, who can facilitate one of the game's major endings by assisting the Courier directly in working toward an independent New Vegas.

q: Who did this? Elite members of the New California Republic are stationed at major military outposts around the Mojave Wasteland.
explanation: Veteran Rangers can be found at most major NCR military outposts, such as Camp Golf, Camp Forlorn Hope, or any of the Ranger stations around the Mojave, after reaching a specific point in the main quest line.

q: Who did this? This crime boss leads a street gang and effectively rules Freeside, helping turn the area into a relatively orderly place.
explanation: The King and his tribe took control of Freeside and created a relatively orderly town out of the multitude of warring gangs and tribes.

explanation: When near the scrapyard, Dogmeat can be found fighting off several raiders.

q: Who did this? A dog in the Capital Wasteland can be recruited as a companion once nearby enemies are killed.
explanation: Once all nearby enemies are killed, he can be recruited as a companion regardless of any Karma rating the player character has (a trait shared with Charon).

q: What is Usanagi skilled enough to install for the Mojave Wasteland?
options: Healing common illness or injury for a fee

Implants that augment physical and mental abilities
explanation: Usanagi is the only person in the Mojave Wasteland that is skilled enough to install implants to augment physical and mental abilities.

q: Who did this? A Followers physician runs a New Vegas medical clinic and offers healing services, including access to permanent stat-boosting implants.
explanation: She offers a variety of healing services and access to permanent stat-boosting implants.

q: What does Aurelius of Phoenix habitually threaten NCR soldiers with in Fallout: New Vegas?
options: acts as the Courier's point of contact for dogtag bounties
pays 10 caps and Legion fame per dogtag
explanation: Aurelius takes pride in his standing as a centurion, but does not take kindly to those he believes are unworthy of superior positions or who test his patience, habitually threatening the latter with crucifixion.

q: Who did this? A Legion centurion stationed by the Colorado River oversees raids against the NCR and contacts the Courier about dogtag bounties.
explanation: Stationed on the western bank of the Colorado River, he oversees Legion operations in the region, coordinates raids against the New California Republic, and serves as the point of contact for the Courier regarding NCR dogtag bounties.

q: In Fallout: New Vegas, Mortimer serves as a right-hand man to the White Glove Society founder. Who is that founder?
explanation: He serves as the hotel maître d' as well as the right-hand man of the organization's founder Marjorie.

q: Who did this? A high-ranking cannibal in the White Glove Society plans to return the group to cannibalism without interference.
explanation: He keeps his beliefs out of earshot now, but only so he can carry out his secret plans to return the White Glove Society to cannibalism covertly without interference from naysayers, which has functionally caused a discreet schism in the White Glove Society, splitting into two camps that disagree over the issue of being a cannibal gourmet.

q: In Fallout: New Vegas, what does Mr. New Vegas do for the Courier's quests?
options: reveals future details of the ending
explanation: He makes comments and gives advice on the Courier's active quests, such as revealing what they must do or is going to do.

q: Who did this? An artificial intelligence created before the Great War hosts a radio show and DJ duties for the Mojave.
explanation: Mr. New Vegas is an artificial intelligence created by Mr. House before the Great War, serving as a radio host and DJ that was put in charge of Radio New Vegas for House's Free Economic Zone of New Vegas following the nuclear apocalypse, a role he continues to occupy by 2281.

q: In Fallout: New Vegas, what role does Tabitha hold at Black Mountain in 2281?
options: starting a 24/7 broadcast of anti-human propaganda
being responsible for saving super mutants from human hands
the nightkin leader of the State of Utobitha
explanation: Tabitha is the nightkin leader of the State of Utobitha and dedicated radio host at Black Mountain in 2281.

q: Who did this? A nightkin leader runs a radio broadcast from Black Mountain and spreads anti-human propaganda across the Mojave.
explanation: With Black Mountain Radio on the air again, Tabitha began broadcasting to the ears of anyone with a radio and started a 24/7 broadcast of anti-human propaganda.

q: By 2287 in the Fallout series, who had a casefile investigating the Mysterious Stranger?
explanation: By 2287, the synth detective Nick Valentine has built up a casefile investigating the Stranger.

q: Who did this? A trench-coat figure appears suddenly during combat, helps with a signature .44 Magnum, and then vanishes.
explanation: He appears suddenly to certain people during combat and assists them with his signature.44 Magnum before vanishing as abruptly as he appeared.

q: Who did this? This former Vault 34 resident led the Boomers tribe at Nellis Air Force Base in the Mojave Wasteland.
explanation: Pearl is a former resident of Vault 34 and the leader of the Boomers tribe inhabiting Nellis Air Force Base in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

q: What can't a Super mutant do because of their bulk in Fallout Tactics?
options: be created by the Master 40 years ago
wear human armor or use small weapons
explanation: and because of their bulk cannot wear human armor or use small weapons.

explanation: Super mutants are characters living in the Midwest in 2197.

explanation: Shaun is unable to age and will remain a child forever.

q: What was Nora working as prior to the war in Fallout 4?
options: earning a law degree at Suffolk County School of Law
explanation: She earned a law degree at Suffolk County School of Law and was working as an attorney prior to the war.

q: Who did this? She is a pre-war resident of Sanctuary Hills in 2077 and one of Fallout 4's possible player characters.
explanation: Nora is a pre-War resident of Sanctuary Hills in 2077 and one of the two possible player characters available during character creation.

q: Where is Manny Vargas living in Fallout: New Vegas, according to the text?
explanation: Manny Vargas is a former Great Khan who is a veteran NCR Army sniper living in Novac.

q: Who did this? This NCR Army sniper in Novac asks the Courier to help with a ghoul problem.
explanation: - Come Fly With Me: Manny will ask the Courier to help him with Novac's ghoul problem in exchange for information about the men who attacked them.

q: What did Freeside thugs do to get by in the Mojave Wasteland?
options: fixing power armor for NCR patrols
explanation: Driven by poverty and chem abuse, they have resorted to thievery and mugging to get by.

q: Who did this? Local bandits armed with basic melee weapons attack people, especially when they are unprotected.
explanation: Freeside thugs are local bandits found in the Mojave Wasteland's Freeside district.

q: What does Ringo give the Courier in Fallout: New Vegas?
options: a map to the Old Mormon Fort
a set of NCR Ranger armor
explanation: Ringo gives the Courier a starter Caravan deck and explains the rules of Caravan.

q: Who did this? This Caravan trader operates in the Mojave Wasteland and hides in Goodsprings after trouble with the Powder Gangers.
explanation: Ringo is a trader for the Crimson Caravan Company operating in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281, forced into hiding in Goodsprings after a run-in with the Powder Gangers.

q: What move does Andy teach the player character in Fallout: New Vegas?
explanation: If one either completes the unmarked quest Andy and Charlie or passes a Speech 30 check when first speaking to him, Andy will teach the player character the Ranger Takedown unarmed move.

q: Who did this? This retired NCR Ranger lives in Novac and watches over the town interior while other ex-snipers keep guard.
explanation: After his discharge, Andy decided on living out his retirement in Novac, where he became the closest the town has to a sheriff, doing his best to watch over the town interior while Manny Vargas and Craig Boone, both retired NCR First Recon sharpshooters, keep up duty as watchmen surveying the roads day and night.

q: What is Dogmeat known for helping the heroes do in the Fallout games?
options: steal a key from the NCR armory
repair power armor for the Brotherhood
destroy the FEV vats at Mariposa
find a water chip to save Vault 13
explanation: The canine traveled with his new master during his adventures to first find a water chip to save Vault 13

explanation: Dogmeat is a dog that has seen the worst of the wasteland and provided a source of companionship to the greatest of heroes it's ever seen.

q: What weapon does Driver Nephi use to kill NCR troopers in Fallout: New Vegas?
explanation: This comes from his signature weapon, a golf driver, with which he has taken the lives of roughly a dozen NCR troopers in melee combat.

q: Who did this? This Fiends leader is a top figure in the Mojave and fights the NCR garrison at Camp McCarran.
explanation: Driver Nephi is a leading member of the Fiends, second only to Motor-Runner, in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

q: What are Jackal gang members generally limited to?
explanation: Most Jackal gang members are generally poorly equipped, with the majority of them being limited to low-level melee weapons such as knives or lead pipes.

q: Who did this? They are low-level raiders in the Mojave Wasteland who are hostile toward most other inhabitants, including the player character.
explanation: Jackals are hostile towards most other Mojave Wasteland inhabitants, including the player character and other raider groups such as the Powder Gangers and Vipers.

q: Who did this? This NCR convict escaped during a mass prison breakout in 2281 and later joined Eddie's newly formed Powder Gangers.
explanation: Like many of the Powder Gangers, Boxcars is a former convict from the NCR Correctional Facility who escaped during the mass breakout orchestrated by Samuel Cooke in 2281 and joined Eddie's newly formed Powder Gangers.

explanation: Dead Sea is a decanus of Caesar's Legion in the Mojave Wasteland who led the assault on the NCR outpost at the town of Nelson, taking it as a base for the Legion and starting a brutal ground war against the Army forces at the nearby Camp Forlorn Hope in 2281.

q: Who did this? He can be found at the Ultra-Luxe casino bar, accompanied by one of his bodyguards.
explanation: He can be found in the Ultra-Luxe casino, sitting at the bar and accompanied by one of his bodyguards, a Gunderson hired hand.

a small gang of Powder Gangers
a group of convicts to raze Goodsprings to the ground
explanation: Joe Cobb is the leader of a small gang of Powder Gangers in 2281.

q: Who did this? He is a Powder Ganger leader in the Mojave Wasteland who runs a small group in 2281.
explanation: Joe Cobb is the leader of a small gang of Powder Gangers in 2281.

q: Who did this? A town guard in Goodsprings who hunted geckos and used her rifle to keep radscorpions and coyotes out of town.
explanation: Her talent with a rifle is also very useful to the people living in the sleepy settlement, helping keep it clear of radscorpions and coyotes which always seem to find a way to get into the town trying to get at the namesake water source.

q: Who did this? A security enforcer for the Van Graffs who lives and works at the Silver Rush weapon shop in Freeside.
explanation: He is Gloria Van Graff's half-brother and her right-hand man, living at the Silver Rush weapon shop in Freeside in 2281.

q: Who did this? He led a hired Great Khan group tied to Benny, and later worked on a plan to return to Red Rock Canyon.

Order workers to wait safely in Sloan

q: Who did this? The NCR foreman at Quarry Junction who was forced out by deathclaws and sheltered in Sloan in 2281.
explanation: Chomps Lewis is the foreman of the Quarry Junction mining operation for the New California Republic in the Mojave Wasteland, recently forced out by an infestation of deathclaws and sheltering in the nearby worker town of Sloan in 2281.

q: Who did this? A Vertibird pilot who became part of the Enclave remnants and later helped with power armor on the frontier.
explanation: In the end, Daisy brought the remnants to the Mojave Wasteland where they put their power armor in storage at the Remnants bunker, then went their separate ways to find a new life on the frontier.

explanation: The deputy is not treated seriously by the other denizens of Primm, on account of his lack of common sense, intelligence, and general usefulness.

escort prisoners for the Legion at Cottonwood Cove
take back the town from escaped convicts
help the Kings run Freeside in 2281

the right-hand man of the King in Freeside

q: What does Neil credit himself for redirecting in Fallout: New Vegas?

the nightkin guarding Tabitha's broadcast station
explanation: For one, he has seen results, crediting himself for having successfully redirected twelve mutants away from Black Mountain towards Jacobstown.

explanation: - Killing Dr. Richards will result in failing both Medical Mystery and Restoring Hope.

a real good claim out east
a gun handy against the Legion

q: What does Rhonda help Tabitha do at Black Mountain?

explanation: Rhonda's subservient protocols consequently helped to stabilize Tabitha's mental state and help her manage her schizophrenia brought on by Stealth Boy overuse.

explanation: Butch has been forced to put on a mask as a boorish, overbearing bully to cover up his deep-seated feelings of inadequacy due to not knowing his father despite living in a Vault with a close-knit community.

q: What was Sofia Daguerre's profession?
explanation: Commander Sofia Daguerre is a United States Space Administration astronaut that crash-landed in Appalachia after awakening from her space-bound cryostasis in 2103.

q: Who did this? This astronaut crash-landed in Appalachia and was found by Vault 76 dwellers.
explanation: Commander Sofia Daguerre is a United States Space Administration astronaut that crash-landed in Appalachia after awakening from her space-bound cryostasis in 2103.

q: Who did this? This Enclave agent was a super mutant and served as the final boss of Fallout 2.
explanation: Special Agent Frank Horrigan is a super mutant and an agent of the Enclave's Secret Service in 2241.

q: What was John Bishop's role in New Reno?
options: Leader of the Bishops crime family
explanation: John Bishop is the power-hungry leader of the Bishops, one of the four crime families controlling New Reno in 2241.

q: Who did this? This AI was developed to predict nuclear war and was later used by the Railroad in the Commonwealth.
explanation: The development of the Predictive Analytic Machine, abbreviated P.A.M., was green-lit in 2067, commissioned under the P.A.M. Initiative. This was a joint project between the Defense Intelligence Agency and the military to develop an advanced artificial intelligence program capable of accurately predicting the future, based on data fed into her systems by her human operators.

q: What is the highest rank in the Brotherhood of Steel?
explanation: A rare and extremely deadly paladin variant, even without power armor they have powerful weaponry at their disposal and may have several pulse or plasma grenades. They level with the player.

q: Who did this? This missionary dedicated himself to protecting the Sorrows and tending to their needs.
explanation: He has dedicated himself to protecting them and tending to their needs.

q: Who did this? This crime lord controlled the Hub through intimidation and manipulation, establishing a loan sharking operation called the Friendly Lending Company.
explanation: He established his power through intimidation and manipulation: He gives protection to the merchants, while turning them on one another, and cynically plays common Hubbers, thugs, and especially the police as he sees fit.

q: Who did this? This scientist led a project involving the Forced Evolutionary Virus and the creation of super mutants.
explanation: Dr. Brian Virgil was a member of the Institute. On April 10, 2286, he was put in charge of a project involving the Forced Evolutionary Virus and the creation of super mutants in the BioScience division.

q: Who did this? This super mutant was imprisoned in Vault 87 for his peaceful nature and interest in learning history.
explanation: Fawkes is a super mutant residing in a cell within Vault 87 in the Capital Wasteland in 2277, imprisoned there by his brethren for his peaceful nature and interest in learning history instead of killing humans.

q: Who did this? This engineer led a team that salvaged a pre-War fusion plant and installed it within the Prydwen, enhancing its long-range travel capabilities.
explanation: Ingram's team salvaged a pre-War fusion plant from a derelict aircraft carrier and installed it within the Prydwen, enhancing its long-range travel capabilities and allowing for a faster arrival to the Commonwealth during their expedition.

q: What is Lucas Simms known for?
options: Being the sheriff and mayor of Megaton
Being a scientist in the Wasteland
Being a leader of the Institute
Being a soldier in the Brotherhood
explanation: Lucas Simms is the sheriff and de facto mayor of Megaton in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

q: Who did this? This man took care of any public duty necessary for the people of his town and dealt with troublemakers by unceremoniously throwing them out of the town.
explanation: Along with his capacity as sheriff, Lucas also takes care of any public duty necessary for the people of his town - mayor, judge, etc. - and deals with most troublemakers by unceremoniously throwing them out of the town.

q: Who did this? This man was one of the more intelligent of the city's denizens and fell from grace after trying to oust Ashur.
explanation: As Ashur's former second-in-command of the Pitt raiders, Wernher is one of the more intelligent of the city's denizens. He fell from grace after trying to oust Ashur.

q: Who did this? This robot was a heavily modified Assaultron retrofitted with sentry bot and Protectron parts.
explanation: Ada is a heavily modified Assaultron retrofitted with sentry bot and Protectron parts.

q: What is Elder Cleric Quintus known for?
options: He is a soldier in New California
He is a leader of the Institute
He is the leader of the Knights of San Fernando
He is a scientist in New California
explanation: Elder Cleric Quintus is the leader of the Knights of San Fernando, a chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel that operates in New California in 2296.

q: Who did this? This elder cleric advanced to the rank of elder cleric and ruled the Knights of San Fernando with a firm hand.
explanation: By 2296, Quintus had advanced to the rank of elder cleric and ruled the Knights of San Fernando with a firm hand.

q: What did Rose do in Fallout 76?
options: Founded the Appalachian Automated Launch System
Invented the Toxic Valley white powder
Built the Top of the World
explanation: Rose is the de facto leader of the Cutthroats raider faction in Appalachia.

q: Who did this? This heavily modified robot ran a research project in the Wasteland and asked the player to test her inventions.
explanation: Rose is a heavily modified Miss Nanny and self-proclaimed leader of the Appalachian raider gangs.

q: What did MODUS do in Fallout 76?
options: Invented the Toxic Valley white powder
Founded the Appalachian Automated Launch System
explanation: The Multi-Operation Directions and Utility System (MODUS) is an artificial intelligence housed within and overseeing the operation of the pre-War military bunker built below the Whitespring Resort in Appalachia.

q: What did Porter Gage do in Fallout 4?
options: Led a raider coalition to take over Nuka-World
explanation: Porter Gage is a raider operating as the second-in-command to Overboss Colter, leader of the raider alliance controlling the pre-War Nuka-World amusement park in 2287.

q: What did Nate do in Fallout 4?
explanation: Nate is a former soldier and decorated war hero who served in the 2nd Battalion, 108th Infantry Regiment of the U.S. Army during the Sino-American War.

q: Who did this? This decorated war hero served in the Sino-American War and was a resident of Sanctuary Hills.
explanation: Nate is a former soldier and decorated war hero who served in the 2nd Battalion, 108th Infantry Regiment of the U.S. Army during the Sino-American War.

q: Who did this? This radio host entertained with music tracks and reported on current events in Diamond City.
explanation: Though he is committed to reporting on current events and entertaining with music tracks, Travis is not exactly the perfect fit for radio as he is constantly self-deprecative, soft-spoken, and severely lacking in self-confidence and charisma, which he has heard plenty about from his listeners before.

q: Who did this? This synth fought for the freedom of other synths and worked with the Railroad.
explanation: Unlike most rescued synths, she opted to join the Railroad and actively fight for her fellow synths' freedom.

q: What did Grahm do in Appalachia?
explanation: Grahm and Chally hosted their "Meat Week" event close to Vault 76, with an express invitation toward the Vault Dwellers.

q: Who did this? This fortune teller used her precognitive powers to predict disasters in Quincy.
explanation: Mama Murphy has supposedly possessed the ability of "the Sight" all her life, claiming it to be a supernatural power that she can only access from the use of chems.

q: What did Knight Titus do in New California?
options: Served as a squire for the Brotherhood of Steel
explanation: In 2296, Titus arrived at the Brotherhood base on a Prydwen-class airship used by the Knights of San Fernando. There, he was assigned Dane as his squire.

q: Who did this? This door-to-door salesman survived the Great War and was changed by radiation into a ghoul.
explanation: Despite being unable to secure a spot inside Vault 111, the Vault-Tec rep managed to survive the nuclear exchange. To his surprise, the radioactive fallout did not kill him but mutated him into a ghoul.

q: What did Mister Burke try to do to Megaton in Fallout 3?
options: Destroy the town with its bomb
Find a cure for the town's illness
explanation: Talking to Mister Burke at Moriarty's Saloon will begin the destruction path of arming and detonating the Megaton bomb to destroy the town.

q: Who did this? This associate of Allistair Tenpenny tried to arrange the destruction of Megaton using the bomb at its center.
explanation: Talking to Mister Burke at Moriarty's Saloon will begin the destruction path of arming and detonating the Megaton bomb to destroy the town.

q: What was Jericho's former occupation before settling in Megaton?
explanation: Jericho is a former raider, currently retired and residing in Megaton in the Capital Wasteland in 2277.

q: Who did this? This retired raider settled in Megaton and sometimes helps defend the settlement from threats.
explanation: While he may occasionally lend his weapon hand in defense of the settlement from various threats including his former raider ilk

q: Who did this? This religious movement reveres radiation and spread from Megaton into the Commonwealth.
explanation: They also revere radiation, which they call "His Glow.” The cult's presence in the Commonwealth is at least partially the result of an expedition sent northward from their cultural center of Megaton in the Capital Wasteland.

q: What did Desmond Lockheart sabotage at Point Lookout?
explanation: At some point, Desmond carried out an unspecified sabotage on the St. Aubin Medical Facility beneath the lighthouse at Point Lookout controlled by his rival Professor Calvert

q: Who did this? This former British intelligence agent became a ghoul and lives in Point Lookout.
explanation: Desmond Lockheart is a former British intelligence agent from the pre-War era turned ghoul. In 2277, he resides in Point Lookout.

q: What does Vic the Trader do for a living in New California?
options: Trades with tribes in the wasteland
Leads the Brotherhood of Steel Outcasts
Hunts escaped synths for the Institute
explanation: Vic the Trader is a wasteland trader who works among the tribes in New California

q: Who did this? This trader works among tribes in New California and can join the Chosen One on their journey.
explanation: He is also a potential companion.

q: Who did this? This Megaton businessman runs a saloon and sells information about the town's residents.
explanation: he deals in information much more than the aforementioned worldly pleasures: he is very knowledgeable regarding the townspeople of Megaton

q: What do Coursers do for the Institute in Fallout 4?
options: Lead the Brotherhood of Steel in Appalachia
Guard the water purifier in Project Purity
explanation: Coursers are elite synth operatives designated to carry out specific surface missions for the Institute, such as tracking down escaped synths.

q: Who did this? These elite synth operatives hunt escaped synths and are trained in combat, infiltration, and tracking.
explanation: Coursers hunt down and reclaim synths that have escaped the Institute. They are highly self-sufficient, trained in combat, infiltration, and tracking.

q: Which group does Henry Casdin lead in the Capital Wasteland?
explanation: Protector Henry Casdin is the leader of the Brotherhood of Steel Outcasts in the Capital Wasteland.

q: Who did this? This former Brotherhood soldier led dissenters away from the Citadel, forming an Outcast group in the Capital Wasteland.
explanation: The dissenters rallied behind Casdin, abandoned Lyons' command and left the Citadel, taking a large part of its weapons and equipment stockpiles with them.

q: Who did this? This former Army Ranger became a founding Brotherhood member and led its Appalachian chapter.
explanation: Taggerdy became known as Paladin Taggerdy, the head of the Appalachian chapter of the Brotherhood.

q: Who did this? This sentry bot took control of a historic ship and is trying to repair and operate its rocket thrust system.
explanation: he has assumed complete control over the ship, having reprogrammed a variety of robots to serve as his crew.

q: What does Mister Handy collect while moving around a floor of a Fallout Shelter vault?
explanation: It will move around on a single floor of the vault collecting resources and defending that floor from incidents.

q: Who did this? This robotic assistant patrols a vault floor, gathering supplies and defending it from incidents.
explanation: It will move around on a single floor of the vault collecting resources and defending that floor from incidents.

q: Who did this? This former crime boss runs a smaller drug business from a Goodneighbor hotel and supplies chems across the region.
explanation: He spends his days running the remains of his drug empire from Hotel Rexford, which he owns.

q: What business does Vadim Bobrov co-own in Diamond City?
explanation: Vadim and his identical twin brother Yefim Bobrov are the proprietors of the Dugout Inn, a bar and hotel which is a popular hangout spot for Diamond City's lower-class residents.

q: Who did this? This cheerful bartender co-owns a Diamond City bar and hotel with his twin brother and likes joking with customers.
explanation: He is a rather cheerful and friendly fellow who enjoys joking around with his customers, who can rather be quite loud.

q: What does Doctor Amari provide to help runaway synths escape notice by the Institute?
options: A chem lab for a drug trade
A rocket thrust system for a ship
explanation: In this capacity, she provides the use of the memory loungers for the purpose of performing a mind-wipe on runaway synths.

q: Who did this? This neural physiology scientist helps the Railroad hide runaway synths by changing their memories at Goodneighbor's Memory Den.
explanation: she provides the use of the memory loungers for the purpose of performing a mind-wipe on runaway synths.

q: Who did this? This Brotherhood officer accepts anyone who fights for his group, regardless of their background, and gives the Warrior missions.
explanation: Unlike his predecessor, who looked down on tribals and initially treated the Warrior with disdain, Dekker accepts anyone who fights for the Midwestern Brotherhood, regardless of their background.

q: What does the Mechanist do to protect people near Canterbury Commons in Fallout 3?
options: Creates and commands an army of robots
Builds and commands an army of super mutants
Trains and commands an army of mercenaries
Repairs and commands an army of combat vehicles
explanation: He has been creating and commanding an army of robots to defend the innocent citizens against attacks by his nemesis, the AntAgonizer.

q: Who did this? This costumed hero commands robots to defend people near Canterbury Commons from attacks by a rival superhero.
explanation: He has been creating and commanding an army of robots to defend the innocent citizens against attacks by his nemesis, the AntAgonizer.

q: What does Sydney specialize in finding in Fallout 3?
explanation: She learned to always be ready for a fight, to the point of sleeping with a gun under her pillow all the time, and perfected her combat skills, becoming a consummate freelance mercenary who specializes in hunting down pre-War treasures and relics.

q: Who did this? This freelance mercenary hunts for old-world treasures and is hired to recover the Declaration of Independence from the National Archives.
explanation: Her latest job is another task from Washington, to recover the Declaration of Independence from the National Archives.

q: What job does Charon have at the Ninth Circle in Fallout 3?
options: He works as the bar's cook
He works as the bar's bartender
He works as the bar's owner
He works as the bar's bouncer
explanation: Charon is a ghoul residing in Underworld in the Capital Wasteland, working as the bouncer for the Ninth Circle bar run by Ahzrukhal in 2277.

q: Who did this? This ghoul guards a bar in Underworld and can join the Lone Wanderer as a combat companion.
explanation: Charon is a ghoul residing in Underworld in the Capital Wasteland, working as the bouncer for the Ninth Circle bar run by Ahzrukhal in 2277.
